name: @agentage/platform-workspace
description: Everything an agentage extension author imports or runs: the extension kit (with the app kit and the dashboard shell), its build tool and the widget kit

scripts.build: npm run css && tsc -b && node scripts/inline-logs.mjs && node scripts/inline-app.mjs && npm run build -w @agentage/shell-dashboard
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/shell-dashboard/dist-e2e packages/shell-dashboard/.vendor packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo coverage packages/widget/src/ds/styles.generated.ts packages/widget/src/test-support/fixture/dist
scripts.type-check: npm run css && tsc -b && tsc -p packages/logs/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/apphost/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/widget/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/identity/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/app/tsconfig.eslint.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shell-dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
